key_idea: Find how many apples came out in all, then share that equally among the 3 bags.
steps: Noah had 18, so he took out 18 - 15 = 3 apples.
He took the same number from each of the 3 bags: 1 + 1 + 1 = 3. So 1 from each bag.

choice_feedback.B: Taking 2 from each bag takes out 6 apples. Then only 12 would be left, not 15.
choice_feedback.C: Taking 3 from each bag takes out 9 apples. Then only 9 would be left, not 15.
choice_feedback.D: Taking 4 from each bag takes out 12 apples. Then only 6 would be left, not 15.
choice_feedback.E: Taking 5 from each bag takes out 15 apples. Then only 3 would be left, not 15.
